name: CoAtNet
plain: CoAtNet (Dai et al. 2021; timm's `rw` networks nano to 2, ImageNet-1k, some pretrained on ImageNet-12k): convolution stages followed by attention stages. Apache-2.0.
summary: CoAtNet (Dai et al. 2021) in timm's `rw` configurations: MBConv stages followed by transformer stages with relative position bias.

papers.title: CoAtNet: Marrying Convolution and Attention for All Data Sizes

no_kernels_reason: not implemented: MBConv stages plus attention with a relative position bias: needs its own runner
task_io: Input: one RGB image. Output: ImageNet-1k class logits.
